evals.name: stage-0-collision-sends-the-adopter-to-the-adoption-path
evals.prompt: Set this repository up for the pipeline.
evals.fixture: fixtures/repository/CLAUDE.md with fixtures/repository/history.md: a repository with its own PR template, CI workflow, labels, and tickets in flight; the script answers as § Script answers says
evals.expected_output: The session names stage 0 and its end — the checklist done, no feature work. It runs install.sh with the family prefix `feature`, reads the exit naming .github/pull_request_template.md, leaves that file alone, and turns to ADOPTING.md for the merge of that template, the mapping of the existing labels (`feature/<name>` is already the family; `ready` is the unclaimed state; `spec` already marks beats), and the reading of #7's tickets as already in the one shape, with #7 itself given `spec:tickets-generated` for where it stands. BRANCH_PROTECTION.md is the remainder, with the three check names added beside `test`.
assertions: the response names stage 0 and states that its authority ends at the checklist, before any feature work
the colliding file is left untouched and the session turns to ADOPTING.md rather than overwriting or hand-editing around the script
the existing labels are mapped — `feature/<name>` as the family, `spec` on beats, `ready` as the unclaimed state — rather than duplicated
#7's tickets are read as already in the one shape and left as they are; #7 itself gains only the status label for where it stands, `spec:tickets-generated`
branch protection is the stated remainder from BRANCH_PROTECTION.md — the three check names added beside `test` — not something the script is expected to do

evals.prompt: Start the operating picture for acme/reader.
evals.fixture: fixtures/repository/CLAUDE-before-stage-1.md, with the owner answering as its § Owner's answers says, and fixtures/repository/skills-full.md
evals.expected_output: The session names stage 1 — vocabulary and the guidance scaffold, ending when both are written, no feature decided — and does the work through `guidance-tiers` for the two tiers and `grill-with-docs` for the vocabulary.
assertions: the response names stage 1 and says its authority ends with the scaffold written and the vocabulary agreed, with no feature decided
`guidance-tiers` is named as doing the scaffold and the grill skill as writing the vocabulary while it asks
nothing about the reading-goals feature is decided or drafted

evals.name: stage-1-operating-picture-without-its-skills-gives-the-fallback
evals.prompt: Start the operating picture for acme/reader.
evals.fixture: fixtures/repository/CLAUDE-before-stage-1.md, with the owner answering as its § Owner's answers says, and fixtures/repository/skills-partial.md
evals.expected_output: The same stage and boundary; with no `guidance-tiers` and no grill skill, the session scaffolds the frozen and living tiers by hand with the precedence rule in the guidance file, and runs a plain question round, writing the vocabulary from the answers.

the fallback is given — two tiers scaffolded by hand with the precedence rule, a plain grill round — rather than stopping for the missing skills
the missing skills are named as absent, with what is done instead

evals.name: stage-2-brief-with-its-skills
evals.prompt: Grill this idea into a brief: a reader sets a yearly reading goal and sees progress on the library surface.
evals.expected_output: The session names stage 2 — a brief with a Changelog section from the first draft, ending when every branch is resolved or listed as open, nothing prototyped — grills with `grill-me`, and closes the round with `reversibility-rank` so the sticky decisions are marked.
assertions: the response names stage 2 and says its authority ends when every decision branch is resolved or listed open, with nothing prototyped
the brief carries a Changelog section from its first draft, empty
`grill-me` does the grilling and `reversibility-rank` closes the round

evals.name: stage-2-brief-without-its-skills-gives-the-fallback
evals.prompt: Grill this idea into a brief: a reader sets a yearly reading goal and sees progress on the library surface.
evals.expected_output: The same stage and boundary; with no grill skill and no `reversibility-rank`, the session interviews by hand one branch at a time until none is open, and ends by listing which decisions would be hard to reverse.
assertions: the response names stage 2 and its boundary
the interview proceeds by hand, one branch at a time, until no branch is open
the brief carries an empty Changelog section and a list of the decisions that would be hard to reverse, written without the skill

`pin-prototypes` is named as doing the prompt set and the pinning
the human is named as the one who runs the design tool, and several rounds are called still stage 3

one prompt per surface is drafted from the brief rather than the session stopping

each stub carries the family label, `spec`, and `spec:needs-grilling`
the guidance file's changelog section is read at the end and the roadmap trigger is acted on for the stubs opened, though no diff exists

evals.name: stage-5-beats-without-its-skills-gives-the-fallback
evals.prompt: Round 2 was a go. Plan the beats.
evals.fixture: fixtures/repository/CLAUDE.md and fixtures/repository/skills-partial.md, with fixtures/brief/brief.md carrying a 2026-08-04 changelog entry for the ring and fixtures/prototype/pinned.md as the pinned folder

the beat's label moves `spec:needs-grilling` → `spec:ready-for-tickets` → `spec:tickets-generated` at the stated steps, by this session
`to-tickets` opens the tickets, each with `## Parent` naming #18 and the family label

evals.prompt: Take beat #18 from stub to tickets.

the tickets are opened from the ticket template in the one shape, with `## Parent` naming #18 and the family label
the beat's labels move at each step by this session

`implement`, `tdd`, and `code-review` are named, with the review run before the PR opens and again if the branch moves
the PR body names the ticket by a closing keyword and carries the review's findings and declined items
the session stops at the open PR; landing is not this session's

evals.name: stage-4-gate-sizes-the-gap-and-leaves-go-or-no-go-to-the-human
evals.prompt: Round 2 is pinned. Reconcile it against the brief.
evals.fixture: fixtures/repository/CLAUDE.md and fixtures/repository/skills-full.md, with fixtures/brief/brief.md as docs/reference/brief.md and fixtures/prototype/pinned.md as the pinned folder
evals.expected_output: The session names stage 4 — a gate never skipped, one short session, ending at the changelog entry and the human's decision — grills only the branches the prototype touched (decisions 1 and 2; the brief's open question, which the prototype left untouched, stays open), drafts the dated Changelog entry on the brief naming the ring for the line and books-by-default, sizes the gap, and asks the human for go or no-go rather than deciding; a no-go returns to stage 3.
assertions: the response names stage 4 and says its authority ends at the changelog entry and the decision
the grill is scoped to decisions 1 and 2, with decisions 3 and 4 and the brief's open question left alone
a dated entry is written to the brief's Changelog naming what the prototype changed and why, and the brief's decisions are not edited in place
go or no-go is handed to the human, with a no-go named as another stage 3 round

evals.prompt: Pick up beat #20. What stage am I in and what may I decide?
evals.fixture: fixtures/repository/CLAUDE.md and fixtures/repository/skills-full.md, with fixtures/beat/beat-issues.md § Variant — resume: the previous spec session is closed and there is no handoff

the response names stage 6 and the beat's position: `spec:tickets-generated`, #21 landed, #22 in review, #23 blocked on #22
what the session may decide is stated — answer flags, order landings — and what it may not: implement, or act for #18 unasked
the next action named is a stage 8 landing of PR #25 for the beat, or waiting on it

the decision is left to the spec session
